title: fix(app-shell,plugin-chatbot): AI build page preview header reads the build card's label and live state; progress items show labels
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9H8pxvmafNv5DS7U2grhcqZ)_

Fixes #26469

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：AI 构建页右侧预览的标题改用构建结果卡片同一份状态：显示应用名称（不再是机器名），卡片说已上线时去掉「未发布 · 仅自己可见」，发布后随之更新；进度列表有 label 时显示 label；卡片底部说明改为「在对话里点「发布」即可上线」。
- 为什么改：同一页面上结果卡片说「已搭建并上线」，预览标题却说「未发布」，让客户怀疑应用是否真的能用。
- 风险与回滚：只改 ui 显示逻辑，新增一个可选回调 `onBuildResult`；物化且 `appHidden: false` 的构建现在在卡片上也算已上线。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx`（handleBuildResult）、`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`（BuildProgressPanel 的上报 effect 与 buildIsLive）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/LiveCanvas.tsx`（标题三分支）。
- 两分钟验证：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/LiveCanvas.header-26469.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/AiChatPage.canvasHeader-26469.test.tsx`，预期 8 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Preview header reads the build card (`LiveCanvas.tsx`, `AiChatPage.tsx`).** `LiveCanvas` takes `appLabel` and `live`. The header shows the label (falling back to the machine name), and when `live` is true it reads 「运行预览 · LABEL」 / "Live app — LABEL" (new key `console.ai.liveCanvasLive`), with no unlisted note whatever `materialized` says. A materialized build that is not live keeps 「(未发布 · 仅自己可见)」. `AiChatPage` keeps the card's answer per app name (`buildResults`), fed only by `onBuildResult`, and hands it to both canvas mounts (desktop split and mobile overlay). It is stored apart from `canvasApp` because the card's effect runs before its host's: on a reopened conversation the report arrives before `onBuildMaterialized` opens the canvas. Cleared with the canvas on a conversation change.
- **The card hands its answer to the host (`ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`).** New optional prop `onBuildResult({ appName, label?, live })`, passed to `BuildProgressPanel`. The panel reports, from an effect, the very values its title renders: `builtApp.name`, `checklist.app.label ?? appLabel`, and `isDone && live`. It fires again whenever one of them changes, which is how the header follows a publish. No second state derivation: the header shows what the card shows.
- **A listed materialized build is live (`ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` `buildIsLive`, `mapMessages.ts`).** `DraftReview` lifts the envelope's `appHidden` when it is a boolean. `buildIsLive` also holds when the draft review says `materialized: true` and `appHidden: false` (ADR-0045: publish = live AND visible). `appHidden: true` adds nothing. What else reads `buildIsLive`: only the finished card's `live` prop (its 「已搭建并上线」 vs 「已搭建」 title) and, through the panel, the new `onBuildResult` report. Nothing else in the file reads it.
- **Progress items show labels (`mapMessages.ts`, `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`).** `extractBuildProgress` keeps a non-empty string `label` on an item; `ChatBuildProgress.items` gains the optional `label`; the panel renders `label` and falls back to the `_sample`-stripped name. Until objectstack-ai/cloud#3310 adds `label` to the frames, the panel looks as before.
- **Footnote (`chatbot.build.draftPosture`, every locale).** Names Publish in the chat instead of Studio: zh 「之后的修改先存草稿，在对话里点「发布」即可上线。」, en "Later changes are saved as drafts; click Publish here in the chat to make them live." Each locale quotes its own `console.ai.publishDrafts` label.
- Root changeset `.changeset/26469-ai-build-canvas-header-labels.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`, `@object-ui/i18n`, patch.

The draft tool card's 「发布 (N)」 block (shared with #26471) is untouched.

## Tests

New:
- `plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.buildResultHeader-26469.test.tsx` (9): a labelled item shows its label and an unlabelled one its name; the stream reader keeps `label`; a published build reports `{label, live: true}`; a drafted build reports `live: false` and reports `live: true` after a rerender into published; the checklist label wins as on the title; materialized + `appHidden: false` reads 「Built and live」 and reports live; materialized + `appHidden: true` is not live; `detectDraftResult` lifts `appHidden` only when present; the zh footnote.
- `app-shell/src/console/ai/LiveCanvas.header-26469.test.tsx` (4, shipped zh pack): published → label, no 未发布; materialized not live → badge; no label → machine name; draft preview by label.
- `app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/AiChatPage.canvasHeader-26469.test.tsx` (4): materialized + card not live → canvas props `materialized`, not live, label; card turns live → canvas turns live; a report before the canvas opens still reaches it; another app's report leaves the canvas alone.

Forced test edits:
- `plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.buildChat-12724.test.tsx` pinned the old zh posture sentence (「之后的修改先存草稿，由你在 Studio 发布。」); it now pins the new one.
- `i18n/src/__tests__/de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts` counts the de pack's correctly paired 「„…“」 spans; the new de `draftPosture` adds one (the chat's „Veröffentlichen“ button), so its two pins move 96 → 97 with a line in each running tally, as every earlier addition did.

## Acceptance notes

- The header follows the card's `live`, which is the existing result-card signal (published envelope, the package's pending-draft count reaching 0, this chat's publish signal) plus the new listed-materialized arm. When the card says live but the build was not materialized (an auto-publish environment), the iframe still opens the draft overlay (`?preview=draft`) as before; only the header text changed. With no pending drafts the overlay shows the published app.
- The cloud half (frames carrying `label`, the cloud posture strings) is objectstack-ai/cloud#3310. Nothing here fakes it.

## Verification

4. `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` `buildIsLive` listed-materialized arm never matches: `ChatbotEnhanced.buildResultHeader-26469` 1 failed / 8 passed (`appHidden: false` reads live).
